LIBRARIAN_BLOCK_PREVIEW_MULTIPLAYER: Other players' turn-end effects may change your Block. The total is determined during resolution.
LIBRARIAN_BLOCK_PREVIEW_HAND: Turn-end hand effects or Exhaust triggers may change Block. The total is determined during resolution.
LIBRARIAN_BLOCK_PREVIEW_EXPIRY: {Amount} old Tidal Block expires this turn end and is included in the change above.
LIBRARIAN_BLOCK_PREVIEW_TOTAL: Current Block: {Current}; turn-end change: {Change}; expected total: {Final}.
LIBRARIAN_BLOCK_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: The blue number is the net change in Block at turn end, including Tide, Waves, Plating and other turn-end effects. Add it to your current shield Block to get expected total Block. A negative number means Block will be lost.
LIBRARIAN_BLOCK_PREVIEW_BOTTOM: Turn-end automatic card plays can affect Block. The total is determined after they resolve.
LIBRARIAN_BLOCK_PREVIEW_EFFECTS: A turn-end effect cannot yet be predicted. Total Block is determined during resolution.
LIBRARIAN_BLOCK_PREVIEW_MODIFIERS: A Block modifier or triggered effect cannot yet be predicted. Total Block is determined during resolution.
LIBRARIAN_BLOCK_PREVIEW_COMBAT: Damage may end combat before later effects resolve.
LIBRARIAN_BLOCK_PREVIEW_RANDOM: Random effects change Block. The ranges show possible net changes and total Block.

LIBRARIAN_ORB_BACK: [gold]Background[/gold]: This orb's settlement effect is halved.
